_comment: Chapter 5 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F21, a payoff: the hungry soldier from chapter 1 (spared: he warns of the nets, a potion; not: the nets fall, -30 HP).

text.zh_TW: 你一走進兵營大門，就聽見有人小聲喊你的名字。
text.en: As you step through the barracks gate, someone whispers your name.

label.zh_TW: 「是你……四層那個餓肚子的士兵？」
label.en: "It's you... the hungry soldier from the fourth floor?"

text.zh_TW: 年輕的士兵摘下面具，臉上還有麵包屑。「他們在門上面架了網，等你走過去。往左邊繞。」他塞給你一瓶藥水。「上次的麵包……謝謝。」
text.en: The young soldier takes off his mask. There are still breadcrumbs on his face. "They've rigged nets above the gate, waiting for you. Go round to the left." He presses a potion into your hand. "For the bread... thanks."

text.zh_TW: 頭頂一暗——一張大網落下來！你和凱在網裡掙扎了好久才砍出一條路。
text.en: Everything goes dark overhead: a huge net drops! You and Kai thrash in it for a long time before you cut your way out.
